name: Fudou Akane
source:
The oldest member and leader of KiLLER KiNG. He has a straightforward personality and strong sense of responsibility, but he also has a fragile and delicate side. He has a history of missing debut opportunities and always underestimates himself.

Miroku is his childhood friend who he met while at his grandfather's dojo. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#fudoakane]official website[/url]]
